ui.noImpact: Task rows and cards replace the visible Personal or Shared word with a person or group icon while retaining the workspace name and the existing localized tooltip and screen-reader context. Task behavior, permissions, settings and documented workflows are unchanged.

release.note: Prepare alpha.12 and Android code12 with the retained signing identity and unchanged protected documentation epoch.

configuration.note: Compose now forwards GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, without which Google sign-in could not be enabled. The new sign-in provider guide documents per-instance OAuth clients, the exact callback, Google redirect-host limits, Compose/AIO/Helm configuration, registration and linking behavior, and planned providers.

deployment.note: Compose forwards GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID alongside the existing secret inputs. The Helm and AIO guides link the sign-in provider guide and show how to supply both Google values through app.extraEnv secret references or the API environment override.

native.note: Document native export source labels and upload times, separate system save dialogs, retained prepared files after cancellation or save failure, and Saved only after a confirmed write.
